test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

She is holding free classes for the poor.

options.text: Free classes are being held for the poor by her.
Free classes have been held for the poor by her.
The poor are holding free classes for her.
Free classes are being held by the poor for her.

solution:
The correct sentence is **"****Free classes are being held for the poor by her**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing from active to passive voice.
 
• The **object **in the **active voice **becomes the **subject **in the **passive voice **as it comes to the front.
 
• In the given sentence, "**Free classes**" becomes the **subject **in the passive voice.
 
• The **subject **in the active voice becomes the **agent "her" **in the passive voice which comes after the preposition "**by**"
 
• In the passive voice, we use the present participle of 'be' which is "**being**" before the main verb in the sentence that is in the present tense.
 
• In the given sentence, the verb "**holding**" in active voice takes the past participle form "**held**" in the passive voice

**The correct sentence is: ***Free classes are being held for the poor by her.*

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
